title_zh: 先了解精神科首次会谈的范围

scenario.label_zh: 澄清首次精神科接待不要求立即讲述全部经历
scenario.goal_zh: 说明首次会谈的顾虑并决定先阅读本诊所的接待说明

context_zh: 虚构诊所信息咨询练习。Eli 向接待员 Farah 询问首次精神科会谈的安排，不涉及诊断或治疗建议。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: I'm reluctant to book a psychiatric appointment because I don't want to explain my whole life at once.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Let me reassure you about our first meeting: it can start with what you want help with now.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Could I read something about the process before deciding?

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Certainly. Our introduction describes the first meeting and the questions you can ask.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Please send that. I'd rather read it before choosing a date.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: I'll email it to you. You don't need to book during this call.
